# netbox_module (Data Source)

A module installed in a device module bay (dcim.module).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/module/):

> A module is a field-replaceable hardware component installed within a device which houses its own child components. The most common example is a chassis-based router or switch.

Similar to devices, modules are instantiated from module types, and any components associated with the module type are automatically instantiated on the new model. Each module must be installed within a module bay on a device, and each module bay may have only one module installed in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_module" "test" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `asset_tag` (String) Unique asset tag.
- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `device_id` (Number) Id of the device.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `module_bay_id` (Number) Id of the module bay the module is installed in.
- `module_type_id` (Number) Id of the module type.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `serial` (String) Serial number.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: offline, active, planned, staged, failed, decommissioning.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `adopt_components` (Boolean) Whether existing components of the device that match the module type's templates are adopted by the module. Only applied when the module is created.
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `last_updated` (String)
- `replicate_components` (Boolean) Whether the components of the module type are created on the device along with the module. Only applied when the module is created.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
